title: Prepare readable test values
responsibility: Builds a bounded presentation of recorded evidence without changing the original values.

inputs.name: recordedValue.value
inputs.description: A value already parsed from a verified JSON recording.

inputs.name: read.value
inputs.description: Recorded JSON value to present without mutating the original.

inputs.name: read.depth
inputs.description: Current nesting depth used to truncate deeply nested presentation.

inputs.name: read.budget
inputs.description: Shared remaining-node budget, decremented while building the bounded presentation.

outputs.name: recordedValue
outputs.description: Typed fields, list items or table cells, limited to four levels and twelve items per collection.
